playstyle: Three Stormcast elites with 5 Health each but only single-shield saves and Move 3, so they are sturdy yet slow. Each swings a hammer, and Inspiring sharpens them: Severin's Stagger no longer needs a critical, Angharad gains Brutal and Obryn Cleave to crack defensive foes. With no warscroll of their own they take a generic Order scroll, either pushing onto enemy treasure or holding home ground with re-rolls and flank immunity. The warband wins by trading blows efficiently and grinding down whatever comes within reach.
